# Captions and Transcripts Reference

Use this reference when a Mux AI workflow depends on speech, captions, transcript URLs, or translated subtitles.

## Auto-generated VOD captions

Mux can generate captions for on-demand assets using `generated_subtitles` on the input object during asset creation:

```json
{
  "inputs": [
    {
      "url": "https://example.com/video.mp4",
      "generated_subtitles": [
        { "language_code": "en", "name": "English CC" }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "playback_policies": ["public"],
  "video_quality": "basic"
}
```

For direct uploads, put caption configuration in `new_asset_settings.inputs[0].generated_subtitles`.

Caption generation does not block initial asset playback. Listen for `video.asset.track.ready` where `text_source` is `generated_vod`.

## Retroactive caption generation

To add generated captions to an existing asset, call the generate-subtitles endpoint on the selected audio track:

```http
POST /video/v1/assets/{ASSET_ID}/tracks/{AUDIO_TRACK_ID}/generate-subtitles
```

Use this when a later AI workflow needs a transcript or when captions were not requested at ingest time.

## Language notes

Stable VOD caption languages include English, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, German, French, and automatic detection. Additional beta languages are supported by Mux but may have lower accuracy.

Avoid using generated captions for mixed-language content unless the product has tested quality. Generated captions are not automatic translation.

## Transcript URLs

When an asset has a ready generated captions track:

```text
https://stream.mux.com/{PLAYBACK_ID}/text/{TRACK_ID}.txt
```

Use `.vtt` instead of `.txt` for WebVTT.

Signed assets require a JWT token with the same audience style used for secure playback:

```text
https://stream.mux.com/{PLAYBACK_ID}/text/{TRACK_ID}.txt?token={JWT}
```

Store track IDs from the asset `tracks` list. Do not infer them.

## Transcript uses

Good downstream uses:

- Summaries and descriptions.
- Chapter generation.
- Key moment detection.
- Search indexing.
- Content classification.
- Moderation review aids.
- Sentiment or insight extraction.

## Caption quality operations

If generated captions are wrong:

1. Download the generated VTT.
2. Edit the text externally.
3. Delete the autogenerated text track.
4. Add a corrected text track to the asset.

For production, expose manual correction or reviewer workflows when caption quality affects user-facing search, accessibility, or policy decisions.
